static_sites.fact: Encoded reply initializer stores caller callback pair in a closure context.
Initializer constructs PreviewsFoundationHost Continuation with resume closure and failure-mode argument.
Result tag branch selects failure handling versus success encoding.
Failure branch obtains serializableNSError through HumanReadableError.
Failure invokes captured callback with null payload and serialized error.
Success invokes captured callback with encoded payload and null error.
Encoded getter checks OS version with arguments 14,4,0.
Data serialization-error fallback calls initWithData with empty Data representation.

limitations: Static selected call sites, not executed callback or live request/reply transport.
No selected callback contains an explicit ServiceMessage identifier copy; absence elsewhere is not established.
Continuation construction does not by itself prove exactly-once callbacks, timeout or cancellation behavior.
OS14.4 version branch and error fallback are not runtime-tested.
Selection-count checks establish symbol isolation, not payload-value acceptance.
No Xcode windows opened; raw disassembly stays local.
